subject: Vendor onboarding: payment sprint & PO terms convergence
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@lumenware.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ap@lumenware.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay ask

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this morning. We're excited to get the PO in the system and start provisioning. A couple of quick asks from our Finance team so we can align with our treasury cadence:

- Can Redwood accept Net 30 for our first three months? Our standard vendor terms are Net 60 but we can shorten for a partner onboarding window.
- We also have an early-pay program — if Redwood can offer a 2% fee for 15-day early payment, our AP can move invoices into the accelerated queue.

I've attached our W-9 and the AP contact sheet. Please confirm whether we should send invoices to ap@lumenware.com or to an AR inbox at Redwood.

Appreciate a quick read on next steps — Samir (cc'd).

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Finance Operations
LumenWare

Attachments: LumenWare_W9.pdf
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@lumenware.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay ask

Samir — thanks for the clear summary and the W-9. Quick responses: 

1) Net terms: Our standard is Net 45 for new partners during the initial provisioning period; we can make an exception to Net 30 for the first 90 days if procurement and finance sign off. I'll loop in Marissa (Procurement) and Ben (Billing).

2) Early-pay program: Redwood runs an early-pay pilot occasionally — the 2% fee for T+15 is within reason, but I need to confirm routing and whether that fee will be handled as an invoice line item or via a settlement adjustment.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to confirm PO intake fields we need filled (I attached our PO template).
- Ben to confirm the AR inbox and whether we can accept invoice metadata for accelerated processing.
- If both align, we run a 60-90 day pilot (Net 30 + early-pay opt-in).

Can you get me the LumenWare PO contact and the name on the initial invoice so we can create the vendor record this afternoon?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, samir@lumenware.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-21T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay ask

Markus / Samir — looping in procurement checklist. A few items before we can finalize Net 30 exception:

- Completed PO intake form (fields: legal entity, remit-to address, tax ID, invoice email, contact person, sample invoice) — Samir, can you confirm those?
- Procurement needs PO approval path documented (who signs vs who approves). If LumenWare needs PO automation, include the vendor code you prefer.
- Compliance: since this is an exception to our default Net 45, Finance requires a risk signoff. Ben — can you indicate what triggers the Net30 exception (revenue threshold / contract length)?

Samir — for accelerated pay, Redwood prefers a settlement adjustment line on the invoice (we then apply the early-pay fee when we remit). If you must have a separate vendor fee, we'll need Finance to approve the flow.

If we get the intake form and sample invoice by tomorrow EOD, I'll route for approvals the same day.

Procurement checklist attached.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Procurement_PO_Intake_Checklist.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, samir@lumenware.com
Date: 2026-08-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay ask

Hi all — quick note from Billing/AR:

- AR inbox: invoices should be sent to ar-invoices@redwood.com with PO#: LW-2026-0921 in the subject. That mailbox is monitored and can kick invoices into the early-pay queue if the vendor elects the pilot.
- Net30 exception: Finance will sign off for the first 90 days for new strategic partners if expected monthly invoicing > $10K. Samir, can you confirm expected monthly run-rate?
- Early-pay handling: we process early-pay as a settlement adjustment on payment. Please include the early-pay election as a line on the invoice (e.g., "Early-pay opt-in: YES — 2% fee"). We cannot accept external fee payments — must be invoiced.

If you include the PO number and the early-pay line, we can include LumenWare in the accelerated pilot and remit on T+15.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@lumenware.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, ap@lumenware.com
Date: 2026-08-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay ask

Thanks — confirming details so we can kick off today:

- Expected monthly billing: ~ $28,000 (est. first 3 months).
- Invoice instructions: send to ar-invoices@redwood.com, include PO# LW-2026-0921.
- Early-pay: we will include the line item exactly as requested ("Early-pay opt-in: YES — 2% fee").
- PO contact: Priya Natarajan (priya@lumenware.com) — please use that name on the first invoice.

We'll fill and return the PO intake form and attach a sample invoice by EOD. Once procurement signs the Net 30 exception, LumenWare will submit the first invoice and opt into the 15-day early-pay queue.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Samir

Attachments: Sample_Invoice_LumenWare.pdf
